listeningQuestions.audio: The motto of the Olympic Games is faster, higher and stronger.
opts: 奥林匹克的格言是更快、更高、更强。
奥运会每四年举办一次。

listeningQuestions.audio: He learned to play basketball on a poor backyard court.
opts: 他是在简陋的后院球场上学会打篮球的。

listeningQuestions.audio: Cooperation between team members is the key to winning.
opts: 队员之间的合作是取胜的关键。

listeningQuestions.audio: She ran the rest of the race with just one shoe on.
opts: 她只穿着一只鞋跑完了余下的比赛。

listeningQuestions.audio: It is no use giving up after losing only one match.
opts: 仅输一场就放弃是没有用的。

listeningQuestions.audio: Doing sport is good for both the body and the mind.
opts: 运动对身体和心灵都有好处。

quizQuestions.q: 合作、团队配合,用哪个词?
(努力)取得成功、得到回报,用哪个短语?
____ basketball on a muddy court taught him to be creative.
It is no use ____ about the result after the game.
quizQuestions.point: 形式主语 it · no use + doing

quizQuestions.q: Watching live matches ____ one of his favourite hobbies.
quizQuestions.point: 动名词主语主谓一致(单数)

quizQuestions.q: ____ as one team matters more than any single star.

opts: 他们刻苦训练终于以一场反扑获胜。
他们一开始就轻松取胜。
quizQuestions.audio: Their hard work paid off with an epic comeback.

opts: 每天早起训练最终很有回报。
quizQuestions.audio: Getting up early to train really pays off in the end.

reading.passage: A sports role model is someone whose hard work and self-belief inspire others. Such people show us that the words faster, higher and stronger are about far more than just winning medals; they are about never giving up.
reading.passageCn: 体育榜样是那种用努力和自信激励他人的人。这样的人让我们明白,'更快、更高、更强'远不只是赢得奖牌,更在于永不放弃。

questions.q: What makes someone a sports role model?
opts: Their hard work and self-belief inspire others.

questions.q: What are the words 'faster, higher, stronger' really about?
opts: Far more than just winning medals.

writing.prompt: Write about an unforgettable sporting moment in about 60 words: what the event was and when, what you saw and heard, and how you felt. Try to use one -ing form as the subject.
writing.promptCn: 用约60词写一个难忘的体育时刻:是什么比赛、何时,你看到和听到了什么,以及你的感受。试着用一个动名词作主语的句子。

lines.text: The sports club is open to everyone. Which sport will you try?
lines.cn: 运动俱乐部对所有人开放,你想尝试哪项运动?

lines.text: I'll try basketball, because I like working with a team.
lines.cn: 我想打篮球,因为我喜欢团队配合。

lines.text: Good choice. Playing as a team is really fun.
lines.cn: 不错的选择,团队打球真的很有意思。

lines.text: I'll join the swimming team. Getting up early is hard, but it pays off.
lines.cn: 我要加入游泳队。早起很难,但很有回报。

lines.text: We lost the final by just two points. I feel awful.
lines.cn: 我们决赛只差两分输了,我太难受了。

lines.text: It is no use giving up after one loss. You all played well.
lines.cn: 输一场就放弃没有用,你们都打得很好。

lines.text: But we trained so hard for it.
lines.cn: 可我们为此训练得那么辛苦。

lines.text: And that hard work will pay off next time. Keep going!
lines.cn: 那些努力下次会有回报的。坚持下去!
